claims.rationale: New scoped programme; no matched discovery at base. Seah, Poon, Leslie and Law, Water June 2003 pp.43–44,46 and PUB 2024 milestone annex p.6 establish Bedok commissioning May 2000, the treatment train and early 2003 full plants. Seah p.46 explicitly dates flow into Bedok and Kranji reservoirs 21 February 2003; PUB overview describes blending and waterworks. Sembcorp 3 August 2009 p.1 dates Changi first-phase service to the preceding Friday, 31 July; PUB milestone annex distinguishes May 2010 formal opening. PUB closure account and 2025/26 report p.13 establish Bedok retirement and other facilities. PUB accounts differ over opening/commissioning months; year-only accepted.

New scoped UCLA membrane, no matched record at base. Inventor Loeb, Reverse Osmosis: Introduction, p.1, describes selective skin, porous support, performance and 1959–1960 window; US patent 3,133,132 face and claims 1,6 document 29 November 1960 filing. UCLA institutional history supplies research location; retrospective dates bounded rather than narrowed to 1959.

New scoped Cadotte design. FilmTec v Hydranautics 982 F.2d 1546 background ¶13,15 and opinion ¶¶29–35 recount notebook evidence, November 1977 desalting and February 1978 tests. The appellate court reversed the ownership judgment and vacated validity/infringement holdings, not an endorsement of infringement. Patent 4,277,344 face and claim 1 support 1981 grant and structure.

Extension of existing Coalinga record, preserving existing dated events and measures. Direction later Coalinga to Loeb–Sourirajan, type adapts: Davis, Stenstrom and McCutchan 1981 §5.2 p.30 traces UCLA researchers’ Coalinga trial to the membrane and subsequent Manjikian refinements; the Coalinga operators Stevens and Loeb 1967 abstract independently describes tubular cellulose acetate and municipal supply. No global first or seawater claim is added.

Direction Cadotte composite toward earlier Loeb–Sourirajan architecture; builds_on refers to the stated selective layer and supporting architecture, not a specific patent license. Cadotte and Petersen 1981 abstract describes separate-layer composites as an improvement approach to the Loeb–Sourirajan structure. Independent Bend Research patent 4,917,800 Background discusses both advances and interfacial polymerization. Patent 4,277,344 claim 1 documents the Cadotte structure.

Direction Bedok demonstration toward Cadotte material is same_family affinity, not derivation or transfer. Seah et al. pp.44,46 identify aromatic polyamide thin-film composite and Hydranautics RO units; 2002 expert panel §1.4 and Cadotte patent 4,277,344 claim 1 support broad comparison. Specific element, manufacturing and licensing route remain unresolved.

PUB 2025/26 report pp.2,13 bounds four existing facilities to reporting period and dates Changi 3 contract and 2028 planned completion; Toray 17 September 2026 reports an order, not commissioning. PUB 2024 records Bedok closure. Sembcorp 2009 p.1 supports Changi 1 service. WABAG describes New Goreangab direct reuse and WHO 2017 potable reuse guidance case table distinguishes 2002 new plant and its listed treatment train from old plant and RO-based schemes. OCWD board packet 18 February 2026 technical exchange report says Kranji retrofit applies to a portion, not Changi 3. The present plant-day status and exact element remain open.

Added source records and notes reviewed against linked original patent texts, project team paper, operator releases, appellate opinion and PUB/participant reports. Notes are selected paraphrases rather than complete preserved source copies; original locators and URLs remain inspectable. Non-original UCLA institutional histories are used only alongside inventor and operator evidence, with their respective retrospective scope.

corrections: Replaced exact 1959 with inventor Loeb’s 1959–1960 range; recorded November 1960 filing separately.

Used year-only Bedok/Kranji formal opening and distinguished February public-use launch; corrected paper locator and avoided treating its incomplete January table entry as independent opening evidence.
Changed Changi trace from reused to used to avoid implying unevidenced transmission.
deferred: Specific Hydranautics element and transfer/licensing from Cadotte remain unverified; same_family is not a transmission claim.
Contemporary original laboratory reports for earliest membrane tests and relation to Reid remain frontier.
Windhoek first plant opening versus first potable supply, current operational production, and Changi 3 commissioning remain open.
